data.registration_trigger: Vacant property and properties in foreclosure (vacant and/or foreclosing properties).
data.ordinance_name: Vineland Code Ch. 530 - Vacant and abandoned property (Secs. 530-11 registration, 530-12 statement & inspection, 530-13 fees, 530-14 owner/creditor requirements)
data.registration_fee: $500 initial per building (2016 amendment); first renewal $1,500 (2017 ordinance); a separate $200/year fee appears for properties in foreclosure. Verify against P.L.2021 c.444 fee limits.

data.summary: Vineland (Ch. 530) requires registration of vacant and foreclosing properties by the owner or creditor, renewed annually; fees include $500 initial and escalating renewals, plus a $200/yr foreclosure fee. NJ municipal registries operate under N.J.S.A. 40:48-2.12s et seq.; P.L.2021, c.444 caps new registration fees at $250 (grandfathering older ordinances).
